summary: Off-duty Pueblo Police Corporal Stephen Biggs reported missing ~5:30 p.m. Sunday after a single-boat accident near Peck Creek, Lake Pueblo State Park; overnight water search by a CPW sonar-equipped patrol boat, Pueblo County Sheriff's Office divers, Pueblo West Fire Department, and the CPW Marine Evidence Recovery Team with an ROV; body located ~2 a.m. Monday Sept 28 in the main channel just east of Peck Creek Cove in ~48 ft of water via towable side-scan sonar and recovered ~2:45 a.m.
location: Main channel just east of Peck Creek Cove, Lake Pueblo State Park
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife Marine Evidence Recovery Team; Pueblo County Sheriff's Office divers; Pueblo West Fire Department
notes: Victim name per multiple news outlets (CBS Denver, KOAA News5) as Pueblo Police Cpl. Stephen Biggs, reportedly in a wakeboarding accident; CPW's release says the Pueblo County Coroner's Office will release the official identity and cause/manner of death. CPW investigating the incident as a fatal boating accident.
